integrity: The global bound uses the published orthogonal-pair reduction and an exact trigonometric maximization of a three-term absolute-sine sum. Sharpness is certified by an explicit orthogonal equality pair. Numerical exploration was not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the real, unit-norm Mercedes frame with Euclidean signal and measurement norms. It does not claim the same constant for complex phase retrieval, other norms, nonuniform weights, common rescalings, or arbitrary three-vector frames.
title: The Mercedes frame has exact global phase-retrieval stability constant \(\sqrt{2}\)
